about: ERW, Should your family get an EV? (/play/ev): the players' cases the replication draws and recomputes. 'opens' is the page as every visitor opens it (the United States, every default). 'every_state' draws each of the 51 states of site/data/ev_prices.json at the defaults, as if chosen in the state menu. Each case of 'moved' is a player's moves: 'code' the state chosen, 'v' the sliders moved (miles, mpg, kwhPerMile, gasCar, evCar, homeShare, years, rate, credit), 'creditOn' the credit switch, 'gas' and 'power' a price slider moved (USD a gallon; USD/MWh, which the page shows as cents a kWh), 'publicCents' what was typed in the public charger's box. Written by session 7536 (chain 304).
